```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8, dpi = 300
)
library(here)
dir.create(here("figures", "main"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(here("figures", "supplement"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(DiagrammeR)
library(rsvg)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(glue)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library(webshot2)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(broom)
library(survRM2)
library(nnet)
library(flextable)
library(sf)
library(httr)
library(haven)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
load(here("data_processed", "03_cohort_with_variables_v2.rda"))
counts <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "02_cohort_counts_v2.rds"))
load(here("data_processed", "01_raw_data_v2.rda"))
```

```{r global-config, include=FALSE}
source(here("scripts_v2", "chunks", "00_global_config.r"))
```

# Main Figures

## Table 1: Baseline Characteristics

```{r table1, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source(here("scripts_v2", "chunks", "table1.r"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

## Figure 1: Bypass Code Usage Over Time

```{r fig1-bypass-trends, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
source(here("scripts_v2", "chunks", "fig1_bypass_trends.r"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

*Three definitional groups:* **EP** = OPTN code 887 (not offered – expedited placement). **OPTN AOOS** = OPTN-defined codes 861, 862, 863, and 799 (with keyword text). **Lit** = literature-based codes 798, 898, and 888 (with keyword text). Code-level detail and definitions are in **Supplemental Table S1**.
